title: Wednesday at Lakeside
湖畔診所的星期三
paras: Nora Brooks was at the front desk of Lakeside Family {{clinic|Clinic}} by seven thirty on Wednesday, the busiest day of the month. By eight fifteen the waiting room was full, and patients were tapping their names into a {{tablet|tablet}} by the door. Dr. Patel, the only full-time {{physician|physician}}, was stuck in traffic.
週三是這個月最忙的一天，諾拉·布魯克斯七點半就坐到湖畔家庭診所的櫃台前。八點十五分，候診室已經坐滿人，病人在門邊的平板上輕點自己的名字報到。診所唯一的全職醫師帕特爾醫師還堵在路上。

Then a man walked up with his hand pressed to his jaw. "I've had a toothache all night," said Mr. Alvarez. "I'm sorry, we don't treat teeth," Nora said. "But the {{dentist|dentist}} next door, Dr. Lin, sees emergencies." While she dialed, a nurse handed him an ice pack to {{relieve|relieve}} the pain.
這時有個男人手按著下巴走過來。「我痛了一整晚的牙，」阿爾瓦雷茲先生說。「很抱歉，我們不看牙齒，」諾拉說，「不過隔壁的林醫師是牙醫，有看急診。」她撥電話的時候，護理師遞給他一個冰敷袋，減輕疼痛。

Next came Mrs. Kim, on the phone. Her son's school bus had broken down, and she needed to {{reschedule|reschedule}} his checkup. "Of course," Nora said. "How about Friday at four?" "Yes, thank you. Honestly, I'm glad your text {{reminder|reminder}} came this morning, or I would have forgotten to call."
接著是金太太打來的電話。她兒子的校車拋錨了，她得把他的健康檢查改期。「當然可以，」諾拉說，「週五下午四點好嗎？」「好，謝謝。老實說，幸好今天早上收到你們的提醒簡訊，不然我可能忘了打來。」

At ten, Mr. Garcia leaned over the counter. "Why did my insurance {{premium|premium}} go up again?" Several people looked up. Nora lowered her voice. "That's up to your insurance company, but I can show you our bill in the back office. Your records are {{confidential|confidential}}, so we shouldn't discuss them out here." He nodded. At noon, Mr. Alvarez came back, smiling, and left a box of cookies.
十點，賈西亞先生趴在櫃台上問：「為什麼我的保險費又漲了？」好幾個人抬頭看過來。諾拉壓低聲音說：「那要看您的保險公司，不過我可以到後面的辦公室讓您看我們的帳單。您的紀錄是機密，我們不該在這裡討論。」他點點頭。中午，阿爾瓦雷茲先生笑著回來了，還留下一盒餅乾。
